items.say: A request enters Flask's W S G I app. It creates and pushes a request context, dispatches, calls the response, and pops the context in finally.
items.caption: A WSGI request enters Flask.wsgi_app. It creates and pushes a request context, dispatches, calls the response, and pops the context in finally.

items.say: Pushing it ensures an application context exists, opens the session, and matches the URL. The rule and view arguments are stored on the request.
items.caption: Pushing it ensures an application context exists, opens the session, and matches the URL. The rule and view arguments are stored on the request.

items.say: Full dispatch request sends request-started and preprocesses. If that returns None, dispatch request calls the view.
items.caption: full_dispatch_request sends request-started and preprocesses. If that returns None, dispatch_request calls the view.

items.say: Before-request hooks run for the application and matched blueprints. The first non-None return short-circuits the remaining hooks and the view.
items.caption: Before-request hooks run for the application and matched blueprints. The first non-None return short-circuits the remaining hooks and the view.

items.say: Dispatch request finds the matched endpoint in view functions and calls it with URL arguments through ensure sync.
items.caption: dispatch_request finds the matched endpoint in view_functions and calls it with URL arguments through ensure_sync.

items.say: Finalize request calls make response. Strings and bytes become bodies; dictionaries and lists use the application's Jason provider.
items.caption: finalize_request calls make_response. Strings and bytes become bodies; dictionaries and lists use the application's JSON provider.

items.say: Process response runs after-request hooks and saves a non-null session. Back in w s g i app, teardown runs as the contexts pop.
items.caption: process_response runs after-request hooks and saves a non-null session. Back in wsgi_app, teardown runs as the contexts pop.

items.say: An application context holds the app, URL adapter, and g. A request context holds the request, routing state, session, flashes, and per-request after-functions.
items.caption: An application context holds the app, URL adapter, and g. A request context holds the request, routing state, session, flashes, and per-request after-functions.

items.say: Current app and request are Local Proxy objects over context variables. They resolve to the active context's app or request on each access.
items.caption: current_app and request are LocalProxy objects over context variables. They resolve to the active context's app or request on each access.

items.say: A blueprint records routes as deferred callbacks. Registration merges its views and hooks into the app, then runs those callbacks.
items.caption: A blueprint records routes as deferred callbacks. Registration merges its views and hooks into the app, then runs those callbacks.

items.say: Config loads Python files, objects, mappings, data files, and environment variables. Most loaders keep uppercase keys; prefixed environment loading parses values and supports nested keys.
items.caption: Config loads Python files, objects, mappings, data files, and environment variables. Most loaders keep uppercase keys; prefixed environment loading parses values and supports nested keys.
